questions.stem_text:
Identify the antecedent of the following conditional proposition: The Bees win their first
game only if either the Aardvarks or the Chipmunks do not win their first games.

options.A: The Bees do not win their first game.
options.B: Both the Aardvarks and the Chipmunks do not win their first games.
options.C: The Chipmunks do not win their first game.
options.D: The Chipmunks win their first game.
options.E: Both the Aardvarks and the Chipmunks win their first games.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The Bees do not win their first game.

questions.stem_text:
Guru Nanak and his successors instructed the use of particular Sikh Ragas in order to
promote which of the following?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Discipline and order

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following is an example of a duty that corresponds to a right to goods and
service?

options.A: John's duty to return to Mary that car that he borrowed from her
options.B: John's duty to allow Mary to pursue goals that she values
options.C: John's duty to not harm Mary
options.D: John's duty to not commit suicide

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - John's duty to return to Mary that car that he borrowed from her

questions.stem_text: Where is the key to liberation found within Sikhism?

options.B: In the strict adherence to the Five Ks
options.D: In the practice of yoga and other physical disciplines
options.E: In acts of charity and service

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - In faith in God
